title: Legacy Enemy Overlays
doc: Gates the older ArmorModel.csv, WeaponModel.csv and MonsterTypeModel.csv runtime overlays. Off by default. Requires ModelRules. These files remain authoring inputs for the native exporter; disabling their runtime application does not exclude their authored armor changes from Enemy Rebalance.
uiDoc: Applies the older enemy overlays. Leave this off when using either the bundled Enemy Rebalance or the Workshop version.

fields.label: Enable Legacy Enemy Overlays
fields.doc: Slices.VerdictForOverlay gates ArmorModel.csv, WeaponModel.csv and MonsterTypeModel.csv before they are opened. ModelRules is also required.
fields.uiDoc: Use the older enemy overlay implementation.
